model:
rachana: 1
sutra: lei-countries
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: lei-country, where: "$.COUNTRY == 'ALL'", priority: 20 }
title: { pill: "GLEIF · Countries", id: "$.COUNTRY", with: "$.NAME" }
strip:
  - { label: "Countries", bind: "$.COUNTRIES", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Entities", bind: "$.ENTITIES", fmt: "entities0" }
  - { label: "Groups headquartered", bind: "$.GROUPS_HEADQUARTERED" }
  - { label: "Lapsed", bind: "$.LAPSED" }
panels:
  - id: countries
    kind: table
    title: "Countries by entities"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.COUNTRY_ROWS"
    limit: 300
    columns:
      - { label: "Country", bind: "link(@.label, 'lei-country')" }
      - { label: "Entities", bind: "@.value", fmt: "entities0", total: true }
  - id: by-country
    kind: hbar
    title: "Entities by country (top 20)"
    key: "F3"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.BY_COUNTRY"
    label: "label"
    value: "value"
    fmt: "entities0"
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "must", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F5: "link('ALL', 'lei-group', 'Every group')", F9: "raw" }
